scope: Local verification of the final read-only smoke runner; full candidate and stable website results are separate immutable proofs
securityTests: Literal and URL-encoded bypass credentials are removed from error messages.
The entire Playwright call log is discarded, including Cookie, Authorization and protection headers.
Single-line Cookie, Set-Cookie, Authorization and JSON header diagnostics are discarded even without knowing their secret values.

previousCandidateSafeAggregateOnly.rawProofHandling: The previous raw proof included request cookies in Playwright diagnostics and is quarantined locally. It must not be committed. No headers, cookies or call logs are reproduced in this receipt.

specificRepairs: Every read-only API/HTML GET uses maxRedirects 0 and maxRetries 1; Playwright retries ECONNRESET only, not HTTP/authentication or factual failures.
Protected browser route promises are tracked per page. Page close follows finite document-load readiness, bounded font readiness and a bounded pending-request drain.
Only exact disposed/target-closed errors caused after intentional page/context teardown are classified as cleanup. Genuine pre-close loading and TLS errors remain failures.

The context waits for registered handlers before closing. All 54 reviewed-text, exact API identity, 255-university, reference-fee, CTA, navigation, mobile and product-console assertions remain enabled.
